entries.zh-Hans: # Svelte 待办事项列表 - 实施计划

entries.en-US: Execute this plan using the `superpowers:subagent-driven-development` skill.
entries.zh-Hans: 使用 `superpowers:subagent-driven-development` 技能执行此计划。

entries.en-US: Building a todo list app with Svelte. See `design.md` for full specification.
entries.zh-Hans: 使用 Svelte 构建一个待办事项列表应用。完整规范请参见 `design.md`。

entries.en-US: Create the Svelte project with Vite.
entries.zh-Hans: 使用 Vite 创建 Svelte 项目。

entries.en-US:
- Run `npm create vite@latest . -- --template svelte-ts`
- Install dependencies with `npm install`
- Verify dev server works
- Clean up default Vite template content from App.svelte
entries.zh-Hans:
* 运行 `npm create vite@latest . -- --template svelte-ts`
* 使用 `npm install` 安装依赖项
* 验证开发服务器正常工作
* 清理 App.svelte 中默认的 Vite 模板内容

entries.en-US:
- `npm run dev` starts server
- App shows minimal "Svelte Todos" heading
- `npm run build` succeeds
entries.zh-Hans:
* `npm run dev` 启动服务器
* 应用显示最小的 "Svelte Todos" 标题
* `npm run build` 成功

entries.en-US: Create the Svelte store for todo state management.
entries.zh-Hans: 创建用于状态管理的 Svelte store。

entries.en-US:
- Create `src/lib/store.ts`
- Define `Todo` interface with id, text, completed
- Create writable store with initial empty array
- Export functions: `addTodo(text)`, `toggleTodo(id)`, `deleteTodo(id)`, `clearCompleted()`
- Create `src/lib/store.test.ts` with tests for each function
entries.zh-Hans:
* 创建 `src/lib/store.ts`
* 定义 `Todo` 接口，包含 id、text、completed
* 创建具有初始空数组的可写 store
* 导出函数：`addTodo(text)`、`toggleTodo(id)`、`deleteTodo(id)`、`clearCompleted()`
* 创建 `src/lib/store.test.ts`，包含每个函数的测试

entries.en-US: - Tests pass: `npm run test` (install vitest if needed)
entries.zh-Hans: * 测试通过：`npm run test`（如果需要，安装 vitest）
为待办事项添加持久化层。

entries.en-US:
- Create `src/lib/storage.ts`
- Implement `loadTodos(): Todo[]` and `saveTodos(todos: Todo[])`
- Handle JSON parse errors gracefully (return empty array)
- Integrate with store: load on init, save on change
- Add tests for load/save/error handling
entries.zh-Hans:
* 创建 `src/lib/storage.ts`
* 实现 `loadTodos(): Todo[]` 和 `saveTodos(todos: Todo[])`
* 优雅地处理 JSON 解析错误（返回空数组）
* 与 store 集成：初始化时加载，更改时保存
* 为加载/保存/错误处理添加测试

entries.en-US:
- Tests pass
- Manual test: add todo, refresh page, todo persists
entries.zh-Hans:
* 测试通过
* 手动测试：添加待办事项，刷新页面，待办事项持久化

entries.en-US: Create the input component for adding todos.
entries.zh-Hans: 创建用于添加待办事项的输入组件。

entries.en-US:
- Create `src/lib/TodoInput.svelte`
- Text input bound to local state
- Add button calls `addTodo()` and clears input
- Enter key also submits
- Disable Add button when input is empty
- Add component tests
entries.zh-Hans:
* 创建 `src/lib/TodoInput.svelte`
* 文本输入绑定到本地状态
* 添加按钮调用 `addTodo()` 并清空输入
* 回车键也可提交
* 输入为空时禁用添加按钮
* 添加组件测试

entries.en-US:
- Tests pass
- Component renders input and button
entries.zh-Hans:
* 测试通过
* 组件渲染输入框和按钮

entries.en-US: Create the single todo item component.
entries.zh-Hans: 创建单个待办事项项组件。

entries.en-US:
- Create `src/lib/TodoItem.svelte`
- Props: `todo: Todo`
- Checkbox toggles completion (calls `toggleTodo`)
- Text with strikethrough when completed
- Delete button (X) calls `deleteTodo`
- Add component tests
entries.zh-Hans:
* 创建 `src/lib/TodoItem.svelte`
* 属性：`todo: Todo`
* 复选框切换完成状态（调用 `toggleTodo`）
* 完成时文本有删除线
* 删除按钮（X）调用 `deleteTodo`
* 添加组件测试

entries.en-US:
- Tests pass
- Component renders checkbox, text, delete button
entries.zh-Hans:
* 测试通过
* 组件渲染复选框、文本、删除按钮

entries.en-US:
- Create `src/lib/TodoList.svelte`
- Props: `todos: Todo[]`
- Renders TodoItem for each todo
- Shows "No todos yet" when empty
- Add component tests
entries.zh-Hans:
* 创建 `src/lib/TodoList.svelte`
* 属性：`todos: Todo[]`
* 为每个待办事项渲染 TodoItem
* 为空时显示 "No todos yet"
* 添加组件测试

entries.en-US:
- Tests pass
- Component renders list of TodoItems
entries.zh-Hans:
* 测试通过
* 组件渲染 TodoItem 列表

entries.en-US: Create the filter and status bar component.
entries.zh-Hans: 创建过滤器和状态栏组件。

entries.en-US:
- Create `src/lib/FilterBar.svelte`
- Props: `todos: Todo[]`, `filter: Filter`, `onFilterChange: (f: Filter) => void`
- Show count: "X items left" (incomplete count)
- Three filter buttons: All, Active, Completed
- Active filter is visually highlighted
- "Clear completed" button (hidden when no completed todos)
- Add component tests
entries.zh-Hans:
* 创建 `src/lib/FilterBar.svelte`
* 属性：`todos: Todo[]`、`filter: Filter`、`onFilterChange: (f: Filter) => void`
* 显示数量："X items left"（未完成数量）
* 三个过滤器按钮：全部、进行中、已完成
* 活动过滤器视觉上高亮显示
* "清除已完成" 按钮（没有已完成待办事项时隐藏）
* 添加组件测试

entries.en-US:
- Tests pass
- Component renders count, filters, clear button
entries.zh-Hans:
* 测试通过
* 组件渲染数量、过滤器、清除按钮

entries.en-US: Wire all components together in App.svelte.
entries.zh-Hans: 在 App.svelte 中将所有组件连接起来。

entries.en-US:
- Import all components and store
- Add filter state (default: 'all')
- Compute filtered todos based on filter state
- Render: heading, TodoInput, TodoList, FilterBar
- Pass appropriate props to each component
entries.zh-Hans:
* 导入所有组件和 store
* 添加过滤器状态（默认：'all'）
* 根据过滤器状态计算过滤后的待办事项
* 渲染：标题、TodoInput、TodoList、FilterBar
* 向每个组件传递适当的属性

entries.en-US:
- App renders all components
- Adding todos works
- Toggling works
- Deleting works
entries.zh-Hans:
* 应用渲染所有组件
* 添加待办事项有效
* 切换状态有效
* 删除有效
确保端到端的过滤工作。

entries.en-US:
- Verify filter buttons change displayed todos
- 'all' shows all todos
- 'active' shows only incomplete todos
- 'completed' shows only completed todos
- Clear completed removes completed todos and resets filter if needed
- Add integration tests
entries.zh-Hans:
* 验证过滤器按钮更改显示的待办事项
* 'all' 显示所有待办事项
* 'active' 仅显示未完成的待办事项
* 'completed' 仅显示已完成的待办事项
* 清除已完成会移除已完成的待办事项，并在需要时重置过滤器
* 添加集成测试

entries.en-US:
- Filter tests pass
- Manual verification of all filter states
entries.zh-Hans:
* 过滤器测试通过
* 手动验证所有过滤器状态
为可用性添加 CSS 样式。

- Completed todos have strikethrough and muted color
- Active filter button is highlighted
- Input has focus styles
- Delete button appears on hover (or always on mobile)

entries.zh-Hans:

* 已完成的待办事项有删除线和柔和颜色
* 活动过滤器按钮高亮显示

entries.en-US:
- App is visually usable
- Styles don't break functionality
entries.zh-Hans:

entries.en-US: Add Playwright tests for full user flows.
entries.zh-Hans: 为完整的用户流程添加 Playwright 测试。

entries.en-US:
- Install Playwright: `npm init playwright@latest`
- Create `tests/todo.spec.ts`
- Test flows:
  - Add a todo
  - Complete a todo
  - Delete a todo
  - Filter todos
  - Clear completed
  - Persistence (add, reload, verify)
entries.zh-Hans:
* 安装 Playwright：`npm init playwright@latest`
* 创建 `tests/todo.spec.ts`
* 测试流程：
  * 添加待办事项
  * 完成待办事项
  * 删除待办事项
  * 过滤待办事项
  * 清除已完成
  * 持久化（添加、重新加载、验证）
